answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the generated src/utils/api-types.d.ts differs from the committed file. The diff changes CatalogHistoryOutput.catalog_history_action, which the branch's catalog-history change affects. The fix is to run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the output. A re-run on the same commit will produce the same diff, so retrying won't help.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
